properties.name: sauti.required-env
properties.description: Environment variables that must be set and non-blank before the application may start. Each profile that talks to real services lists its own; startup fails naming every missing one.

properties.name: sauti.crypto.encryption-key
properties.description: AES-256-GCM key for encrypted columns: 32 random bytes in Base64. Set through APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

properties.name: sauti.crypto.hash-key
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for lookup hashes of encrypted values: 32 random bytes in Base64, different from the encryption key. Set through HASH_KEY.
